column2: CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_by_app_version (`minute` DateTime, `app_version` LowCardinality(String), `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, app_version, toInt64(sum(net) OVER (PARTITION BY app_version, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT minute, app_version, sum(delta) AS net FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY minute, app_version)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_by_audio_language (`minute` DateTime, `audio_language` LowCardinality(String), `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, audio_language, toInt64(sum(net) OVER (PARTITION BY audio_language, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT minute, audio_language, sum(delta) AS net FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY minute, audio_language)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_by_country (`minute` DateTime, `country` LowCardinality(String), `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, country, toInt64(sum(net) OVER (PARTITION BY country, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT minute, country, sum(delta) AS net FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY minute, country)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_by_platform (`minute` DateTime, `platform` LowCardinality(String), `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, platform, toInt64(sum(net) OVER (PARTITION BY platform, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT minute, platform, sum(delta) AS net FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY minute, platform)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_by_player_version (`minute` DateTime, `player_version` LowCardinality(String), `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, player_version, toInt64(sum(net) OVER (PARTITION BY player_version, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT minute, player_version, sum(delta) AS net FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY minute, player_version)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_by_subtitle_language (`minute` DateTime, `subtitle_language` LowCardinality(String), `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, subtitle_language, toInt64(sum(net) OVER (PARTITION BY subtitle_language, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT minute, subtitle_language, sum(delta) AS net FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY minute, subtitle_language)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_minute_delta_norm (`minute` DateTime, `platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `subtitle_language` LowCardinality(String), `player_version` LowCardinality(String), `audio_language` LowCardinality(String), `app_version` LowCardinality(String), `platform_norm` LowCardinality(String), `country_norm` LowCardinality(String), `audio_language_norm` String, `subtitle_language_norm` String, `player_version_norm` LowCardinality(String), `app_version_norm` LowCardinality(String), `audio_class` String, `subtitle_class` String, `delta` SimpleAggregateFunction(sum, Int64), `starts` SimpleAggregateFunction(sum, Int64), `ends` SimpleAggregateFunction(sum, Int64)) AS SELECT minute, platform, country, content_id, subtitle_language, player_version, audio_language, app_version, lower(trimBoth(toString(platform))) AS platform_norm, lower(trimBoth(toString(country))) AS country_norm, if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language)))) AS audio_language_norm, if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language)))) AS subtitle_language_norm, lower(trimBoth(toString(player_version))) AS player_version_norm, replaceRegexpOne(lower(trimBoth(toString(app_version))), '^([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)(\\.0+)+$', '\\1') AS app_version_norm, multiIf((if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language)))) IN ('', 'unk', 'und', 'nil', 'null', 'na', 'n/a', 'undefined', 'unknown')), 'unknown', (if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language)))) IN ('off', 'non', 'none', 'disabled')), 'off', (if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language)))) IN ('aut', 'auto')), 'auto', 'named') AS audio_class, multiIf((if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language)))) IN ('', 'unk', 'und', 'nil', 'null', 'na', 'n/a', 'undefined', 'unknown')), 'unknown', (if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language)))) IN ('off', 'non', 'none', 'disabled')), 'off', (if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language)))) IN ('aut', 'auto')), 'auto', 'named') AS subtitle_class, delta, starts, ends FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_minute_series (`platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `minute` DateTime, `concurrent` Int64) AS WITH change_points AS (SELECT platform, country, content_id, toStartOfHour(minute) AS hour, minute, sum(delta) AS d FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY platform, country, content_id, hour, minute), curve AS (SELECT platform, country, content_id, hour, minute AS chg_minute, toInt64(sum(d) OVER w_run) AS concurrent, leadInFrame(toUInt32(minute), 1, toUInt32(toUInt32(hour) + 3600)) OVER w_fwd - toUInt32(minute) AS hold_s FROM change_points WINDOW

column1: w_run AS (PARTITION BY platform, country, content_id, hour ORDER BY minute ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),

w_fwd AS (PARTITION BY platform, country, content_id, hour ORDER BY minute ASC ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)) SELECT platform, country, content_id, minute, max(concurrent) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT platform, country, content_id, toDateTime(arrayJoin(range(toUInt32(chg_minute), toUInt32(chg_minute) + hold_s, 60))) AS minute, concurrent FROM curve UNION ALL SELECT platform, country, content_id, toDateTime(arrayJoin(range(toUInt32(hour) + 3600, toUInt32(hour) + 7200, 60))) AS minute, toInt64(0) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT DISTINCT platform, country, content_id, hour FROM curve)) GROUP BY platform, country, content_id, minute

column2: CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_minute_series_total (`minute` DateTime, `concurrent` Int64) AS WITH change_points AS (SELECT toStartOfHour(minute) AS hour, minute, sum(delta) AS d FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY hour, minute), curve AS (SELECT hour, minute AS chg_minute, toInt64(sum(d) OVER w_run) AS concurrent, leadInFrame(toUInt32(minute), 1, toUInt32(toUInt32(hour) + 3600)) OVER w_fwd - toUInt32(minute) AS hold_s FROM change_points WINDOW

column1: w_run AS (PARTITION BY hour ORDER BY minute ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),

w_fwd AS (PARTITION BY hour ORDER BY minute ASC ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)) SELECT minute, max(concurrent) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT toDateTime(arrayJoin(range(toUInt32(chg_minute), toUInt32(chg_minute) + hold_s, 60))) AS minute, concurrent FROM curve UNION ALL SELECT toDateTime(arrayJoin(range(toUInt32(hour) + 3600, toUInt32(hour) + 7200, 60))) AS minute, toInt64(0) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT DISTINCT hour FROM curve)) GROUP BY minute

column2: CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_publish_lag (`publish_cursor` Nullable(DateTime64(3)), `ingest_watermark` Nullable(DateTime64(3)), `publish_lag_s` Nullable(Int64), `pending_sessions` Nullable(UInt64), `last_committed_run` Nullable(UInt64), `last_run_ms` Nullable(UInt64), `last_run_sessions` Nullable(UInt32), `runs_in_flight` Nullable(UInt64)) AS WITH (SELECT max(cursor_to) FROM sonyliv.cc_publish_runs WHERE phase = 'committed') AS cursor_, (SELECT max(marked_at) FROM sonyliv.session_dirty) AS ingest_wm, (SELECT max(run_id) FROM sonyliv.cc_publish_runs WHERE phase = 'committed') AS last_run SELECT cursor_ AS publish_cursor, ingest_wm AS ingest_watermark, greatest(0, dateDiff('second', cursor_, ingest_wm)) AS publish_lag_s, (SELECT uniqExact(video_session_id) FROM sonyliv.session_dirty WHERE marked_at NOT IN (SELECT marked_at FROM sonyliv.cc_publish_consumed)) AS pending_sessions, last_run AS last_committed_run, (SELECT sum(elapsed_ms) FROM sonyliv.cc_publish_runs WHERE run_id = last_run) AS last_run_ms, (SELECT sessions FROM sonyliv.cc_publish_runs WHERE (run_id = last_run) AND (phase = 'committed')) AS last_run_sessions, (SELECT count() FROM (SELECT run_id FROM sonyliv.cc_publish_runs GROUP BY run_id HAVING countIf(phase = 'committed') = 0)) AS runs_in_flight FROM system.one

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_rolling_dim (`platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `minute` DateTime, `concurrent` Int64, `peak_5m` Int64, `peak_15m` Int64, `peak_60m` Int64, `integral_5m` Int64, `integral_15m` Int64, `integral_60m` Int64, `avg_5m` Float64, `avg_15m` Float64, `avg_60m` Float64, `obs_5m` UInt64, `obs_15m` UInt64, `obs_60m` UInt64) AS SELECT platform, country, content_id, minute, concurrent, max(concurrent) OVER w5 AS peak_5m, max(concurrent) OVER w15 AS peak_15m, max(concurrent) OVER w60 AS peak_60m, sum(concurrent) OVER w5 * 60 AS integral_5m, sum(concurrent) OVER w15 * 60 AS integral_15m, sum(concurrent) OVER w60 * 60 AS integral_60m, (sum(concurrent) OVER w5 * 60) / (5 * 60) AS avg_5m, (sum(concurrent) OVER w15 * 60) / (15 * 60) AS avg_15m, (sum(concurrent) OVER w60 * 60) / (60 * 60) AS avg_60m, count() OVER w5 AS obs_5m, count() OVER w15 AS obs_15m, count() OVER w60 AS obs_60m FROM sonyliv.v_cc_minute_series WINDOW

column1: w5 AS (PARTITION BY platform, country, content_id ORDER BY toUInt32(minute) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 240 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
w15 AS (PARTITION BY platform, country, content_id ORDER BY toUInt32(minute) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 840 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),
w60 AS (PARTITION BY platform, country, content_id ORDER BY toUInt32(minute) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 3540 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

column2: CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_rolling_total (`minute` DateTime, `concurrent` Int64, `peak_5m` Int64, `peak_15m` Int64, `peak_60m` Int64, `integral_5m` Int64, `integral_15m` Int64, `integral_60m` Int64, `avg_5m` Float64, `avg_15m` Float64, `avg_60m` Float64, `obs_5m` UInt64, `obs_15m` UInt64, `obs_60m` UInt64) AS SELECT minute, concurrent, max(concurrent) OVER w5 AS peak_5m, max(concurrent) OVER w15 AS peak_15m, max(concurrent) OVER w60 AS peak_60m, sum(concurrent) OVER w5 * 60 AS integral_5m, sum(concurrent) OVER w15 * 60 AS integral_15m, sum(concurrent) OVER w60 * 60 AS integral_60m, (sum(concurrent) OVER w5 * 60) / (5 * 60) AS avg_5m, (sum(concurrent) OVER w15 * 60) / (15 * 60) AS avg_15m, (sum(concurrent) OVER w60 * 60) / (60 * 60) AS avg_60m, count() OVER w5 AS obs_5m, count() OVER w15 AS obs_15m, count() OVER w60 AS obs_60m FROM sonyliv.v_cc_minute_series_total WINDOW

column2: CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_tumbling_dim AS SELECT platform, country, content_id, toStartOfInterval(minute, toIntervalMinute({win:UInt32})) AS window_start, toStartOfInterval(minute, toIntervalMinute({win:UInt32})) + toIntervalMinute({win:UInt32}) AS window_end, {win:UInt32} AS window_minutes, max(concurrent) AS peak, argMax(minute, (concurrent, -toInt64(toUInt32(minute)))) AS peak_minute, sum(concurrent) * 60 AS integral, (sum(concurrent) * 60) / ({win:UInt32} * 60) AS avg_concurrent, count() AS obs_minutes FROM sonyliv.v_cc_minute_series WHERE throwIf((60 % {win:UInt32}) != 0, 'v_cc_tumbling_dim: win must divide 60 (hour-clipped model, ADR 0003)') = 0 GROUP BY platform, country, content_id, window_start

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_tumbling_hour (`platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `window_start` DateTime, `window_end` DateTime, `window_minutes` UInt8, `peak` Int64, `peak_minute` DateTime, `integral` Int64, `avg_concurrent` Float64) AS SELECT platform, country, content_id, hour AS window_start, hour + toIntervalHour(1) AS window_end, 60 AS window_minutes, peak, peak_minute, integral, integral / 3600 AS avg_concurrent FROM sonyliv.cc_hour_agg FINAL

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_tumbling_total AS SELECT toStartOfInterval(minute, toIntervalMinute({win:UInt32})) AS window_start, toStartOfInterval(minute, toIntervalMinute({win:UInt32})) + toIntervalMinute({win:UInt32}) AS window_end, {win:UInt32} AS window_minutes, max(concurrent) AS peak, argMax(minute, (concurrent, -toInt64(toUInt32(minute)))) AS peak_minute, sum(concurrent) * 60 AS integral, (sum(concurrent) * 60) / ({win:UInt32} * 60) AS avg_concurrent, count() AS obs_minutes FROM sonyliv.v_cc_minute_series_total WHERE throwIf((60 % {win:UInt32}) != 0, 'v_cc_tumbling_total: win must divide 60 (hour-clipped model, ADR 0003)') = 0 GROUP BY window_start

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_watermark (`raw_watermark` Nullable(DateTime64(3)), `sealed_watermark` Nullable(DateTime), `sealed_lag_s` Nullable(Int64), `hour_tier_last_hour` Nullable(DateTime), `hour_final_through` Nullable(DateTime), `hour_tier_last_hour_complete` Nullable(UInt8), `trend_watermark` Nullable(DateTime)) AS WITH (SELECT max(event_timestamp) FROM sonyliv.ev_raw) AS raw_wm, (SELECT max(minute) FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta) AS sealed_wm, (SELECT max(hour) FROM sonyliv.cc_hour_agg FINAL) AS last_hour SELECT raw_wm AS raw_watermark, sealed_wm AS sealed_watermark, dateDiff('second', sealed_wm, raw_wm) AS sealed_lag_s, last_hour AS hour_tier_last_hour, if(raw_wm >= (last_hour + toIntervalHour(1)), last_hour + toIntervalHour(1), last_hour) AS hour_final_through, raw_wm >= (last_hour + toIntervalHour(1)) AS hour_tier_last_hour_complete, sealed_wm AS trend_watermark FROM system.one

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_cc_window_range AS WITH toDateTime({p_start:DateTime}) AS rs, toDateTime({p_end:DateTime}) AS re, toUInt32(if((toUInt32(rs) % 3600) = 0, toUInt32(rs), (intDiv(toUInt32(rs), 3600) + 1) * 3600)) AS whole_lo, toUInt32(intDiv(toUInt32(re), 3600) * 3600) AS whole_hi, whole AS (SELECT max(peak) AS pk, sum(integral) AS ig, count() AS hrs FROM sonyliv.cc_hour_agg FINAL WHERE (platform = {p_platform:String}) AND (country = {p_country:String}) AND (content_id = {p_content_id:Int64}) AND (hour >= toDateTime(whole_lo)) AND (hour < toDateTime(whole_hi))), partial_hours AS (SELECT arrayJoin(arrayDistinct(arrayFilter(h -> ((h < whole_lo) OR (h >= whole_hi)), [toUInt32(intDiv(toUInt32(rs), 3600) * 3600), toUInt32(intDiv(toUInt32(re) - 1, 3600) * 3600)]))) AS h), partial_curve AS (SELECT minute, toInt64(sum(d) OVER w_run) AS concurrent, leadInFrame(toUInt32(minute), 1, toUInt32(toUInt32(hour) + 3600)) OVER w_fwd AS next_minute FROM (SELECT toStartOfHour(minute) AS hour, minute, sum(delta) AS d FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta WHERE (toStartOfHour(minute) IN (SELECT toDateTime(h) FROM partial_hours)) AND (({p_platform:String} = '*') OR (platform = {p_platform:String})) AND (({p_country:String} = '*') OR (country = {p_country:String})) AND (({p_content_id:Int64} = -1) OR (content_id = {p_content_id:Int64})) GROUP BY hour, minute) WINDOW

column1: w_run AS (PARTITION BY hour ORDER BY minute ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW),

w_fwd AS (PARTITION BY hour ORDER BY minute ASC ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING)), partial AS (SELECT maxIf(concurrent, b > a) AS pk, sum(if(b > a, concurrent * toInt64(b - a), 0)) AS ig, countIf(b > a) AS chg FROM (SELECT concurrent, greatest(toUInt32(minute), toUInt32(rs)) AS a, least(next_minute, toUInt32(re)) AS b FROM partial_curve)) SELECT rs AS range_start, re AS range_end, toUInt32(re) - toUInt32(rs) AS range_seconds, {p_platform:String} AS platform, {p_country:String} AS country, {p_content_id:Int64} AS content_id, greatest(whole.pk, partial.pk) AS peak, whole.ig + partial.ig AS integral, (whole.ig + partial.ig) / (toUInt32(re) - toUInt32(rs)) AS avg_concurrent, whole.hrs AS hours_from_hour_tier, partial.chg AS change_points_from_minute_tier FROM whole CROSS JOIN partial WHERE throwIf(toUInt32(re) <= toUInt32(rs), 'v_cc_window_range: p_end must be strictly after p_start') = 0

column2: CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_category_now (`category` String, `concurrent` Int64, `as_of` DateTime) AS SELECT category, argMax(concurrent, minute) AS concurrent, max(minute) AS as_of FROM sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_category GROUP BY category

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_day (`platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `day` Date, `peak` Int64, `peak_minute` DateTime, `integral` Int64, `avg_concurrent` Float64, `active_hours` UInt64) AS SELECT platform, country, content_id, toDate(hour) AS day, max(cc_hour_agg.peak) AS peak, argMax(cc_hour_agg.peak_minute, (cc_hour_agg.peak, -toInt64(toUInt32(cc_hour_agg.peak_minute)))) AS peak_minute, sum(cc_hour_agg.integral) AS integral, sum(cc_hour_agg.integral) / 86400 AS avg_concurrent, count() AS active_hours FROM sonyliv.cc_hour_agg FINAL GROUP BY platform, country, content_id, day

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_day_total (`day` Date, `peak` Int64, `peak_minute` DateTime, `integral` Int64, `avg_concurrent` Float64, `active_hours` UInt64) AS SELECT toDate(hour) AS day, max(cc_hour_agg.peak) AS peak, argMax(cc_hour_agg.peak_minute, (cc_hour_agg.peak, -toInt64(toUInt32(cc_hour_agg.peak_minute)))) AS peak_minute, sum(cc_hour_agg.integral) AS integral, sum(cc_hour_agg.integral) / 86400 AS avg_concurrent, count() AS active_hours FROM sonyliv.cc_hour_agg FINAL WHERE (platform = '*') AND (country = '*') AND (content_id = -1) GROUP BY day

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_hour (`platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `hour` DateTime, `peak` Int64, `peak_minute` DateTime, `integral` Int64, `avg_concurrent` Float64) AS SELECT platform, country, content_id, hour, peak, peak_minute, integral, integral / 3600 AS avg_concurrent FROM sonyliv.cc_hour_agg FINAL

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_hour_total (`hour` DateTime, `peak` Int64, `peak_minute` DateTime, `integral` Int64, `avg_concurrent` Float64) AS SELECT hour, peak, peak_minute, integral, integral / 3600 AS avg_concurrent FROM sonyliv.cc_hour_agg FINAL WHERE (platform = '*') AND (country = '*') AND (content_id = -1)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute (`minute` DateTime, `platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, platform, country, content_id, toInt64(sum(sum(delta)) OVER (PARTITION BY platform, country, content_id, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY minute, platform, country, content_id

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_audio_norm (`minute` DateTime, `audio_language_norm` String, `audio_class` String, `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, audio_language_norm, audio_class, sum(sum(delta)) OVER (PARTITION BY toStartOfHour(minute), audio_language_norm ORDER BY minute ASC) AS concurrent FROM sonyliv.v_cc_minute_delta_norm GROUP BY minute, audio_language_norm, audio_class

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_category (`minute` DateTime, `category` String, `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, category, toInt64(sum(net_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY category, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT minute, if(category_raw = '', '(blank)', category_raw) AS category, sum(delta) AS net_delta FROM (SELECT minute, delta, dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'category', tuple(content_id)) AS category_raw FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta) GROUP BY minute, category)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_content (`minute` DateTime, `platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `title` String, `video_type` String, `category` String, `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, platform, country, content_id, if(dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'title', tuple(content_id)) = '', '(blank)', dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'title', tuple(content_id))) AS title, if(dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'video_type', tuple(content_id)) = '', '(blank)', dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'video_type', tuple(content_id))) AS video_type, if(dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'category', tuple(content_id)) = '', '(blank)', dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'category', tuple(content_id))) AS category, concurrent FROM sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_delta_total (`minute` DateTime, `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, toInt64(sum(sum(delta)) OVER (PARTITION BY toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta GROUP BY minute

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_intervals (`minute` DateTime, `concurrent` UInt64) AS SELECT toDateTime(m) AS minute, uniqExact(video_session_id) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT video_session_id, arrayJoin(range(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(interval_start)), toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(interval_end)) + 1, 60)) AS m FROM sonyliv.session_intervals FINAL) GROUP BY minute

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_intervals_dim (`minute` DateTime, `platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `concurrent` UInt64) AS SELECT toDateTime(m) AS minute, platform, country, content_id, uniqExact(video_session_id) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT video_session_id, platform, country, content_id, arrayJoin(range(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(interval_start)), toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(interval_end)) + 1, 60)) AS m FROM sonyliv.session_intervals FINAL) GROUP BY minute, platform, country, content_id

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_naive (`minute` DateTime, `concurrent` UInt64) AS SELECT toDateTime(m) AS minute, uniqExact(video_session_id) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT video_session_id, arrayJoin(range(toUInt32(toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(s))), toUInt32(if(e > toStartOfMinute(e), toUInt32(toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(e))), toUInt32(toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(e))) - 60)) + 60, 60)) AS m FROM (SELECT video_session_id, min(event_timestamp) AS s, max(event_timestamp) AS e FROM sonyliv.ev_raw GROUP BY video_session_id)) GROUP BY minute

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_stateless (`minute` DateTime, `platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `concurrent` UInt64) AS SELECT minute, platform, country, content_id, uniqExactMerge(active_state) AS concurrent FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_stateless GROUP BY minute, platform, country, content_id

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_title (`minute` DateTime, `title` String, `catalog_content_ids` UInt64, `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, title, catalog_content_ids, toInt64(sum(net_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY title, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT a.minute AS minute, if(a.title_raw = '', '(blank)', a.title_raw) AS title, toUInt64(ifNull(f.content_ids, 0)) AS catalog_content_ids, a.net_delta AS net_delta FROM (SELECT minute, title_raw, sum(delta) AS net_delta FROM (SELECT minute, delta, dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'title', tuple(content_id)) AS title_raw FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta) GROUP BY minute, title_raw) AS a LEFT JOIN (SELECT title, uniqExact(content_id) AS content_ids FROM sonyliv.content_dim GROUP BY title) AS f ON f.title = a.title_raw)
CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_total (`minute` DateTime, `concurrent` UInt64) AS SELECT minute, uniqExactMerge(active_state) AS concurrent FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_stateless GROUP BY minute

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_video_type (`minute` DateTime, `video_type` String, `concurrent` Int64) AS SELECT minute, video_type, toInt64(sum(net_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY video_type, toStartOfHour(minute) ORDER BY minute ASC)) AS concurrent FROM (SELECT minute, if(video_type_raw = '', '(blank)', video_type_raw) AS video_type, sum(delta) AS net_delta FROM (SELECT minute, delta, dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'video_type', tuple(content_id)) AS video_type_raw FROM sonyliv.cc_minute_delta) GROUP BY minute, video_type)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_title_now (`title` String, `concurrent` Int64, `as_of` DateTime, `catalog_content_ids` UInt64) AS SELECT title, argMax(concurrent, minute) AS concurrent, max(minute) AS as_of, max(catalog_content_ids) AS catalog_content_ids FROM sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_title GROUP BY title

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_concurrency_video_type_now (`video_type` String, `concurrent` Int64, `as_of` DateTime) AS SELECT video_type, argMax(concurrent, minute) AS concurrent, max(minute) AS as_of FROM sonyliv.v_concurrency_minute_video_type GROUP BY video_type

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_content_orphan_check (`orphan_content_ids` UInt64, `orphan_events` UInt64) AS SELECT uniqExact(e.content_id) AS orphan_content_ids, count() AS orphan_events FROM sonyliv.ev_raw AS e ANTI LEFT JOIN sonyliv.content_dim AS c ON e.content_id = c.content_id

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_content_title_collisions (`title` String, `content_ids` UInt64, `categories` UInt64, `video_types` UInt64, `ids` Array(Int64)) AS SELECT title, uniqExact(content_id) AS content_ids, uniqExact(category) AS categories, uniqExact(video_type) AS video_types, arraySort(groupArray(content_id)) AS ids FROM sonyliv.content_dim GROUP BY title HAVING content_ids > 1

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_dimension_drift (`dimension` String, `normalised` String, `class` String, `variants` UInt64, `raw_values` Array(String), `rows` UInt64) AS SELECT dimension, normalised, class, variants, raw_values, rows FROM (SELECT 'audio_language' AS dimension, if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language)))) AS normalised, multiIf((if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language)))) IN ('', 'unk', 'und', 'nil', 'null', 'na', 'n/a', 'undefined', 'unknown')), 'unknown', (if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language)))) IN ('off', 'non', 'none', 'disabled')), 'off', (if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(audio_language)))) IN ('aut', 'auto')), 'auto', 'named') AS class, uniqExact(audio_language) AS variants, arraySort(groupUniqArray(audio_language)) AS raw_values, count() AS rows FROM sonyliv.ev_raw GROUP BY normalised, class UNION ALL SELECT 'subtitle_language', if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language)))), multiIf((if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language)))) IN ('', 'unk', 'und', 'nil', 'null', 'na', 'n/a', 'undefined', 'unknown')), 'unknown', (if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language)))) IN ('off', 'non', 'none', 'disabled')), 'off', (if(position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') > 0, substring(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), 1, position(lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language))), '-') - 1), lower(trimBoth(toString(subtitle_language)))) IN ('aut', 'auto')), 'auto', 'named'), uniqExact(subtitle_language), arraySort(groupUniqArray(subtitle_language)), count() FROM sonyliv.ev_raw GROUP BY 2, 3 UNION ALL SELECT 'player_version', lower(trimBoth(toString(player_version))), 'n/a', uniqExact(player_version), arraySort(groupUniqArray(player_version)), count() FROM sonyliv.ev_raw GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'app_version', replaceRegexpOne(lower(trimBoth(toString(app_version))), '^([0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+)(\\.0+)+$', '\\1'), 'n/a', uniqExact(app_version), arraySort(groupUniqArray(app_version)), count() FROM sonyliv.ev_raw GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'platform', lower(trimBoth(toString(platform))), 'n/a', uniqExact(platform), arraySort(groupUniqArray(platform)), count() FROM sonyliv.ev_raw GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'country', lower(trimBoth(toString(country))), 'n/a', uniqExact(country), arraySort(groupUniqArray(country)), count() FROM sonyliv.ev_raw GROUP BY 2) WHERE variants > 1 ORDER BY rows DESC

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_dimension_drift_summary (`dimension` String, `groups_with_variants` UInt64, `raw_values_involved` UInt64, `rows_in_split_groups` UInt64) AS SELECT dimension, count() AS groups_with_variants, sum(variants) AS raw_values_involved, sum(rows) AS rows_in_split_groups FROM sonyliv.v_dimension_drift GROUP BY dimension ORDER BY rows_in_split_groups DESC

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_session_minutes (`minute` DateTime, `video_session_id` String, `user_id` String, `platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `title` String, `app_version` LowCardinality(String), `audio_language` LowCardinality(String), `subtitle_language` LowCardinality(String), `player_version` LowCardinality(String)) AS SELECT toDateTime(m) AS minute, video_session_id, user_id, platform, country, content_id, dictGet('sonyliv.dict_content', 'title', tuple(content_id)) AS title, app_version, audio_language, subtitle_language, player_version FROM (SELECT video_session_id, user_id, platform, country, content_id, app_version, audio_language, subtitle_language, player_version, arrayJoin(range(toUInt32(toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(interval_start))), toUInt32(toDateTime(toStartOfMinute(interval_end))) + 60, 60)) AS m FROM sonyliv.session_intervals FINAL)

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_user_concurrency_minute (`minute` DateTime, `platform` LowCardinality(String), `country` LowCardinality(String), `content_id` Int64, `concurrent_users` UInt64) AS SELECT minute, platform, country, content_id, uniqExactMerge(active_state) AS concurrent_users FROM sonyliv.cc_user_minute GROUP BY minute, platform, country, content_id

CREATE VIEW sonyliv.v_user_concurrency_minute_total (`minute` DateTime, `concurrent_users` UInt64) AS SELECT minute, uniqExactMerge(active_state) AS concurrent_users FROM sonyliv.cc_user_minute GROUP BY minute
